test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can complete a certain job in 18 days. B is 40% more efficient than A. How many days will B alone take to complete the same job?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete a certain job in 18 days.

B is 40% more efficient than A.

**Calculation:**

40% = 2/5

Efficiency of A : Efficiency of B = 5 : 7

So, total work = Time taken × Efficiency = 18 × 5 = 90 unit

Now,

Time taken by B alone to complete the work = 90 / 7 = 126over7 days

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
